verdict.rationale: The manual documents both halves of the story. An Amend toggle in the commit dialog changes the latest commit. Swiping left on an unpushed commit undoes it and leaves its changes in the working directory, and hunk-level staging then lets you recommit them as separate commits, which covers splitting. Further history editing (Delete Commit, Edit Message, Squash) adds depth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the amend/undo/split workflow.
